name: Hermey
subtitle: Your Hermes bots, on your phone
description: Native client for a self-hosted Hermes Agent. Every bot (Hermes profile) is reachable through one gateway; approvals, streaming replies and tool output appear in the conversation. Builds are unsigned and must be re-signed by your sideloading app.

apps.name: Hermey
apps.subtitle: Your Hermes bots, on your phone
apps.localizedDescription: Chats with every Hermes bot, streaming replies, tool cards, inline approvals and per-device pairing.

versions.localizedDescription: Native iOS and macOS client for your own Hermes agent.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan the pairing code shown by your Hermes host to connect this device.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Hermes connects to your own Hermes host over your private network.
